request_schema.description: The `HttpRequest` fields the adapter reads. The http worker sends more (`method`, `query_params`, `path_params` and the stream channels); they are ignored.

body.description: The request body parsed as JSON; `null` when it is empty or not JSON.

headers.description: The request headers. `content-length` and `transfer-encoding` tell a body that is not JSON from an empty one.

path.description: The matched route's path: `/worktree/...`, the function id with `::` as `/`.

request_schema.title: RestRequest

response_schema.description: The `HttpResponse` the http worker answers with.
response_schema.title: RestResponse
